name: alessio-os
description: Multi-agent orchestrator PTI con shared memory SurrealDB, STT italiano, OCR Apple Vision

scripts.app:build: mkdir -p build/AlessioOS.app/Contents/MacOS && cp app/AlessioOS/Info.plist build/AlessioOS.app/Contents/ && swiftc -O -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit -framework Speech -framework AVFoundation -o build/AlessioOS.app/Contents/MacOS/AlessioOS app/AlessioOS/main.swift && codesign --force --sign - build/AlessioOS.app
scripts.schema:apply: surreal sql --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8000 --username root --password root --namespace research --database knowledge < schema/agent_tables.surql

author: Alessio Cazzaniga <alessio.cazzaniga87@gmail.com>
